decisions.reason: I accept this dataset because it provides hourly NO2 measurements for an Italian city, making it relevant to the UC1 air-quality prototype. Its single-site coverage and missing-value limitations will be evaluated during profiling.
Accept for N6 prototype only: it must not be mapped to production because its data ends in 2023.
Accept as an intentional distractor. It is not suitable for the Italian study area, and its domain must remain outside the allowlist so the pipeline records the refusal.
